papers.title: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
papers.summary: LingBot-Touch is a tactile foundation model that learns a unified, extensible representation across heterogeneous tactile sensors, yielding plug-and-play tactile tokens that consistently enhance manipulation policies such as diffusion policy and VLA models.

papers.title: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
papers.summary: WorldFoundry offers open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation of generative world models across video, 3D/4D, embodied action, and interactive systems, with traceable evidence and benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: 开源基础设施，用于可复现地推理与评测视频、3D/4D、具身动作等生成式世界模型，并提供可追溯证据。

papers.title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
papers.summary: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions,
papers.summary_zh: 受元认知启发的科学发现架构，借助已有认知决定探究什么、如何探究，并持续修正对证据的理解。

papers.title: Toward the Era of Agentic Embodied Intelligence
papers.summary: An embodied multi-agent framework uses learned correction codes and a vision-language-action model with motion-aware history and latent world modeling to improve robot control, failure recovery, and training efficiency.
papers.summary_zh: 具身多智能体框架，结合学习到的纠错码与运动感知的VLA模型，提升机器人控制、故障恢复与训练效率。

papers.title: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?
papers.summary: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. We present PCBRouteAgent,
papers.summary_zh: 提出PCBRouteAgent智能体，考察LLM智能体在复杂板级PCB布线中的可靠性与工程能力差距。

papers.title: Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning
papers.summary: Reframe is a two-stage post-training framework that aligns visual agents’ observation states through evidence-aware reinforcement learning and observation-gated on-policy distillation, improving tool use and outperforming Mix-RL and vanilla MOPD across image and video benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: 两阶段后训练框架，通过证据感知强化学习与观测门控的在线蒸馏对齐视觉智能体观测，提升工具使用能力。

papers.title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
papers.summary: A method compresses KV caches by predicting values from keys within each attention head and applying cross-layer low-rank key compression, enabling higher decoding throughput and composability with quantization and eviction.
papers.summary_zh: 在每个注意力头内由键预测值并做跨层低秩键压缩，压缩KV缓存，提升解码吞吐并可与量化、淘汰方法组合。

papers.title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
papers.summary: Flide is an exact inference engine that accelerates decision-model LLM agents by decoupling logical request trees from physical execution and using ForkAttention to preserve exact branch evaluations.
papers.summary_zh: 精确推理引擎，通过解耦逻辑请求树与物理执行并用ForkAttention保留分支评估，加速决策型LLM智能体。

papers.title: ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts
papers.summary: Reproducing machine learning experiments requires reconstructing procedures from information scattered across papers, released code, and supporting artifacts. For coding agents, reproduction success can therefore depend on their ability to fill in missing details, rather than on the released artifac
papers.summary_zh: 在ML研究产物中构建可复现性，帮助编码智能体从论文、代码和附属材料中补全缺失细节以复现实验。

papers.title: Fast and Exact Relative-Position Attention via Structure-Aware Kernels
papers.summary: An exact tiled attention algorithm integrates additive relative-position terms into FlashAttention-style computation, reducing memory and compute overhead and accelerating long-context relative-position transformers.
papers.summary_zh: 将相对位置项精确融入FlashAttention式分块注意力，降低显存与计算开销，加速长上下文Transformer。

papers.title: Longtail-SWE: High-Quality SWE Tasks for Underrepresented Languages
papers.summary: Challenging repository-level benchmarks remain limited for many programming language ecosystems, where filtering scarce candidates with ambiguous descriptions or defective tests can discard valuable engineering problems. We introduce Longtail-SWE, a benchmark of 202 issue-resolution tasks across 13
papers.summary_zh: 构建Longtail-SWE基准，涵盖13种小众编程语言的202个仓库级问题修复任务，弥补资源稀缺语言的评测空缺。

papers.title: InfraRSI: Harnessing Recursive Self-Improvement for Training Infrastructure
papers.summary: While Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) accelerates isolated algorithm and kernel synthesis, distributed LLM training depends on tightly coupled launch settings, operator kernels, and communication schedules, where single edits often hit out-of-memory (OOM) boundaries, compiler conflicts, measurement
papers.summary_zh: 用递归自我改进优化分布式LLM训练基础设施，应对显存溢出、编译冲突等耦合配置问题。

papers.title: SIRIS: Can LLMs Tell When Simulation Errors Matter in AI-Driven Systems Research
papers.summary: A benchmark probes whether large language models can determine when imperfect simulator limitations invalidate recommended system designs, finding that identifying a limitation does not ensure correct design choices and that review-based self-correction yields mixed results.
papers.summary_zh: 基准测试LLM能否判断仿真器误差何时会使AI系统设计结论失效，发现识别局限不等于做出正确设计选择。

papers.title: How Much Training-Inference Mismatch Can On-Policy Distillation Tolerate?
papers.summary: On-policy distillation tolerates substantial training-inference mismatch from quantized inference and asynchronous rollouts, with model- and layer-specific limits, and a lightweight admission check plus FP8 recipes can exploit this tolerance to improve training efficiency.
papers.summary_zh: 研究在线蒸馏对量化推理与异步采样失配的容忍度，提出轻量准入检查和FP8方案以提升训练效率。

papers.title: Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
papers.summary: Language model deployment often requires different trade-offs between competing objectives as user preferences change, yet standard post-training methods typically produce a single policy for a fixed objective weighting. We introduce LambdaMix, a new parameter efficient method for learning a prefere
papers.summary_zh: 提出LambdaMix，用联合训练的低秩适配器学习可调偏好，使语言模型按用户偏好在多目标间灵活权衡。

papers.title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
papers.summary: Reasoning caches built from LLM traces can efficiently apply previously derived solutions to new problem instances with robustness and much lower invocation cost than source models.
papers.summary_zh: 基于LLM推理轨迹构建推理缓存，将已推导的解法复用于新问题，调用成本远低于源模型且鲁棒性好。

papers.title: MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification
papers.summary: Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models can follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. We introduce MotionGraphicsBench, an expert-curated benchmark of
papers.summary_zh: 提出MotionGraphicsBench，以程序化验证评测LLM生成动态图形时对空间、外观与时间要求的遵循程度。

papers.title: TRIO: Task Refinement with Individual Optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.summary: TRIO coordinates three specialized agents through iterative refinement and individual optimization objectives to improve retrieval-augmented generation by enhancing query expansion, retrieval judgment, and answer accuracy.
papers.summary_zh: TRIO通过三个专门智能体迭代精炼并分别优化，改进检索增强生成中的查询扩展、检索判断与答案准确率。

papers.title: Hierarchical Residuals: A Minimalist Decoupling of Residual Width from Compute Width
papers.summary: Hierarchical Residuals decouple residual width from per-layer compute width by connecting standard Transformer blocks through a wider outer residual path, improving efficiency and accuracy without specialized kernels.
papers.summary_zh: 通过更宽的外层残差路径连接标准Transformer块，解耦残差宽度与计算宽度，无需专用内核即可提效提质。

papers.title: FewStepRL: Fine-tuning Few-step Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning objectives for diffusion models are reformulated for few-step samplers through x-space transformation, gradient decomposition, and anchor adaptation, yielding modular few-step variants of several methods and showing reward-gradient methods excel with differentiable rewards while DiffusionNFT-style methods achieve high rewards in fewer iterations.
papers.summary_zh: 通过x空间变换等方法将扩散模型强化学习目标适配到少步采样器，可微奖励下梯度类方法表现最好。
